sloka: सोऽमात्यमध्येभरतो जननीमभ्यकुत्सयत् ।राज्यम् न कामये जातु मन्त्रये नापि मातरम् ॥२-७५-२॥
transliteration: so'mātyamadhyebharato jananīmabhyakutsayat ।rājyam na kāmaye jātu mantraye nāpi mātaram ॥2-75-2॥

translations.english: Neither did I ever desire the kingdom nor did I ever consult my mother in this regard and I am not even aware of the consecration that was planned by the king for I was away in a distant country with Satrughna.
translations.hindi: पिता और पिता के समान भाई से रहित होने के कारण, मेरा तो सब नाश हो गया । ऐसी शोच्य दशा में, मैं राज्य. ले कर करू गा ही क्या १
